Hội An · Vietnam · 2026

Photo Tours

Three private experiences built around light, timing, and genuine access — to places most visitors never reach. Small groups, no rush.

I've lived in Hội An for years. I know the fishermen by name, the alleys that catch the best morning light, and the exact moment the market comes alive. These aren't tours I researched — they're the places I photograph every week.

Tour 01 · Duy Hai

Dawn at the Fishing Village

Silhouettes, nets, and salt air at sunrise.

Documentary · Coastal
When4:30 – 9:00 AM
Duration4.5 hours
LevelAll levels
GroupMax 4 people

What you'll photograph

  • Round basket boats (thuyền thúng) launching before first light
  • Fishermen sorting the night's catch on the sand
  • The spontaneous fish market — faces, color, movement
  • Traditional trawlers silhouetted against a golden horizon
  • Long exposure waves and boat reflections at the shore

Included

Private transport,Coffe, Bánh mì (Vietnamese Sandwich) and Photography Guidance.

$95 / person
Enquire
Tour 02 · Old Town

Old Town Before the Crowds

Architecture, color, and real market life — before the tourists arrive.

Most Requested · Street · Architecture · Market
When6:00 – 9:30 AM
Duration3.5 hours
LevelAll levels
GroupMax 4 people

What you'll photograph

  • UNESCO yellow walls in soft morning raking light — textures, shadows, depth
  • Empty alleys and iconic facades before the day begins
  • The morning market: tropical fruit, fresh seafood, vendors in conical hats
  • Color and authentic street life — real Hội An, not the postcard version
  • The Japanese Covered Bridge — architecture, symmetry, quiet reflection

Included

Private transport · Printed shot list · Market breakfast together · Full image selection assistance

$110 / person
Enquire
Tour 03 · Thu Bon River

River Life at First Light

Mist, reflection, and slow movement from a wooden boat.

Documentary · Landscape · Boat
When6:00 – 9:00 AM
Duration3 hours
LevelAll levels
GroupMax 4 people

What you'll photograph

  • Fishermen casting nets from a traditional wooden boat
  • Morning mist drifting over still water
  • Coconut palm reflections and flooded rice paddies
  • Basket boats navigating narrow river channels
  • Rural river-bank life — farmers, children, daily rhythm

Included

Private wooden boat · Local river guide · Printed shot list · Full image selection assistance

$105 / person
Enquire
